Kacke.et: An onomatopoeic creation relating to the sound a baby makes when pressing while defecating (“a-a-”); compare Aa machen as well as Latin cacō, Ancient Greek κακκάω (kakkáō).

s: a piece of feces that has roughly the form of a sausage
Kackwurst.et: Compound of Kacke (“caca, crap”) or kacken (“to crap, to shit”) + Wurst (“sausage”). From the similarity of feces with sausage (in form).

s: an ugly type of brown, similar in color to feces
Wenn du das kackbraune Hemd anziehst, kannst du alleine weggehen!

a term of abuse for a woman
Kachel.et: From Middle High German kachel, kachele, from Old High German chachala, from Vulgar Latin *cacculus, from cāccabus (“cooking pot”), from Ancient Greek κάκκαβος (kákkabos, “a pot or a pan”). Cognate with Alemannic German Kakel.

Kachelofen.et: From Middle High German kacheloven. Equivalent to Kachel + Ofen.

s: shit-bird (term of abuse, primarily used as an insult against other humans)
ugly person (usually a woman, but can also refer to a man or child)
